summary: Lianhe Sowell International Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting a best-efforts public offering of 7,638,889 units at $1.44 per unit, each consisting of one Class A ordinary share and three warrants, raising gross proceeds of approximately $11 million. The offering closed on September 3, 2026, with R.F. Lafferty as placement agent. Proceeds are allocated 40% to R&D and 60% to working capital. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation.
